notes: YEAR TABLE for style-1: year codes 1995-2029 from Reznor date-code tables in manufacturer documentation (Reznor parts-manual mirror, LDAP manual, date-code chart PDF), three sources agreeing on the sequential pattern (first two letters advance one step per year; third letter A-L is the month, already shipped); BK=2011 matches the Building Center page example. EXTENDED (image-pass Nov 8) to 1975-1994 from the Building Center 1949-1989 and 1990-2029 year charts, read cell-for-cell. New examples use serials quoted in the source documents themselves, not invented: BLL00000X (manualsdir decoding example, BLL = December 2012) and BOG30600000 (parts-guide sample, BOG = July 2015). Two secondary copies contain obvious typos disregarded here (one duplicates the 2015 BO row for 2017; one prints 'BFID'/'Bill' for 2008 rows; one prints 'BIB' for a 2020 row) — the pattern itself is unaffected. NOT INCLUDED: single-letter codes A-Z for 1949-1974 -- chart-verified but held for lack of a real example serial (the schema forbids invented examples). The 2-letter key is the ratified string-keyed table kind (Phase 2b schema). The 2-letter-prefix variant (1-letter year code, per the page tip) is not encoded at all: no year table and no disambiguation rule for it appear in the fetched content, and such serials do not match the style-1 pattern, so they return cannot-determine. Page last updated 2016; parent is as stated on the page.

styles.era: Letter-prefix serials starting with three letters: year is the first two letters, month is the third letter
9-character serials: month is the 1st and 2nd digits, year is the 3rd and 4th digits
